activeAero.quote: DRS was removed from Formula One for the 2026 season, and was replaced with an "active aerodynamics" system under the new 2026 regulations.

aeroTestingRestriction.quote: In 2021, the championship introduced a sliding scale system to regulate aerodynamic testing.

budgetCap.quote: The championship introduced a budget cap, with teams limited to spending a maximum of $145 million per year.
budgetCap.note: Antes de 2021 no hubo techo de gasto

drs.quote: DRS was used in Formula One from 2011 to 2025, with Jenson Button and Andrea Kimi Antonelli being the first and the last to use it, respectively.

energySystem.quote: the FIA allowed the use of 60 kW (82 PS; 80 bhp) KERS in the regulations for the 2009 Formula One season.
energySystem.note: KERS se permite por primera vez en 2009

engineFormula.quote: 1.5 litre turbocharged engines compulsory (with unlimited number of cylinders, RPM and power output).

engineFormulas.note: Conjunto de fórmulas de los motores de f1db; el generador aborta si no coincide

mandatoryDryCompounds.note: Sin obligación de usar dos compuestos antes de 2007 (de memoria)

parcFerme.quote: According to the FIA Formula One regulations (used since 2003), the area must be sufficiently large and secure so as to prevent unauthorised access to the cars, while allowing technical checks to take place.

pitLaneSpeed.note: Sin límite de velocidad en el pit lane antes de 1994 (conocimiento general, SIM-FISICA §4.4 NV). Valores en km/h de carrera; periodos con fecha de inicio y excepciones por id de circuito de f1db (WP6, RF-SIM-12).

pointsScheme.quote: For the Drivers' Championship, the best eleven results were counted, while, for the Constructors' Championship, all rounds were counted.
pointsScheme.note: Comprobado por el generador contra los puntos de cada resultado y las clasificaciones de f1db

refuelling.quote: Refuelling, now banned in F1 races, was permitted until 1983, and then again from the 1994 season to the 2009 season.

rule107.quote: The 107% rule was introduced for the 1996 season and remained in force until 2002.

safetyCar.quote: Formula One officially introduced safety cars in 1993, after trials were conducted at both the French and British Grands Prix during the preceding 1992 season.

sprintWeekends.note: Rondas con resultados de sprint en f1db

teamOrdersBanned.quote: After the 2002 season, FIA announced that "Team Orders that could influence the outcome of a race" were banned, although they were sometimes still implemented discreetly.

topTenStartTyres.note: Sin regla de neumático de salida para los diez primeros (de memoria)

tyreChangesInRace.quote: A major change in 2005 was the outlawing of tyre changes during pit stops.

tyreType.quote: Slick tyres were introduced to Formula One by Firestone at the 1971 Spanish Grand Prix.

unitLimits.quote: To reduce costs, a rule was introduced that each engine must last the entire race weekend.
unitLimits.note: Primer límite de motores en 2004: antes, libres

vsc.quote: The system was evolved taking into account drivers' feedback and was officially introduced for the 2015 season following ratification by the World Motor Sport Council (WMSC).

calendar.name: Spain
calendar.officialName: Gran Premio Tio Pepe de España 1986

teams.name: Lola
teams.entrant: Team Haas USA Ltd / Team Haas USA Ltd

title.es: Frank Williams, herido en un accidente de tráfico en Francia
title.en: Frank Williams is injured in a road accident in France

body.es: Poco antes de empezar la temporada, el fundador del equipo queda en silla de ruedas; Patrick Head dirige el equipo durante su recuperación.
body.en: Shortly before the season, the team's founder is left in a wheelchair; Patrick Head runs the team while he recovers.

title.es: Solo motores turbo: los atmosféricos quedan prohibidos este año
title.en: Turbo engines only: naturally aspirated engines are banned this year

body.es: Toda la parrilla usa motores turbo de 1,5 litros con un límite de 195 litros de combustible por carrera.
body.en: The whole grid runs 1.5-litre turbo engines with a 195-litre fuel limit per race.

title.es: Jerez: Senna gana a Mansell por 14 milésimas
title.en: Jerez: Senna beats Mansell by 14 thousandths

body.es: Uno de los finales más ajustados de la historia: Mansell remonta con neumáticos nuevos y se queda a centímetros.
body.en: One of the closest finishes ever: Mansell closes in on fresh tyres and falls short by inches.

title.es: Fallece Elio de Angelis tras un accidente en unos test en Paul Ricard
title.en: Elio de Angelis dies after a testing crash at Paul Ricard

body.es: El piloto de Brabham muere un día después del accidente. La Fórmula 1 recorta después el trazado del circuito francés.
body.en: The Brabham driver dies a day after the crash. Formula 1 later shortens the French circuit's layout.

title.es: Primer Gran Premio tras el Telón de Acero, en Hungaroring
title.en: The first Grand Prix behind the Iron Curtain, at the Hungaroring

body.es: Piquet gana en Budapest tras un adelantamiento por fuera a Senna.
body.en: Piquet wins in Budapest after a pass around the outside of Senna.

title.es: México: primera victoria de Berger y de Benetton
title.en: Mexico: a first win for Berger and for Benetton

body.es: Berger termina sin cambiar neumáticos y da a Benetton su primer triunfo, con motor BMW.
body.en: Berger runs without a tyre stop and gives Benetton its first win, with BMW power.

title.es: Adelaida: revienta un neumático de Mansell y Prost revalida el título
title.en: Adelaide: Mansell's tyre explodes and Prost retains the title

body.es: Mansell llegaba líder; su neumático trasero estalla a alta velocidad. Williams retira a Piquet por precaución y Prost gana carrera y campeonato. Williams es campeón de constructores.
body.en: Mansell arrived as leader; his rear tyre bursts at high speed. Williams calls Piquet in as a precaution and Prost wins race and title. Williams take the constructors' crown.
